name: Wolf
source: The protagonist. He has no recollection of his past life. While he was wondering what was happening, a little humanoid (kemonomimi) lamb found him and asked him for help. From time to time this character notices how identical his situation is with the story of "[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Little_Red_Riding_Hood]Little Red Riding Hood[/url]".
